0.content: Varesa is Iansan's "star student, my pride and joy". Iansan noticed her when Varesa knocked a hilichurl's club flying and it struck Iansan on the head. She took over Varesa's training, gave her father a meal plan, then rewrote it once she understood Varesa's extraordinary metabolism, and got her into the tribe's Patrol Team, where Iansan usually gives her orders. Iansan says Varesa can lift more than she can and only lacks confidence. She worries that Varesa is too relaxed and eats too much sugar; Varesa sneaks snacks at a secret campsite.

1.content: Iansan does not like leaning on anyone, but she says following Mavuika feels natural, "like moving towards the light when you're surrounded by darkness", because she trusts her as a close friend. Early in her Pilgrimage career, rivals ganged up on her. Mavuika advised her to prove her strength beyond doubt, and Iansan did so by challenging Mavuika herself in the arena; she fought well enough that no one underestimated her again. Mavuika also advised her to charge for classes.

2.content: Emela was an orphaned baby Tatankasaurus raised by the Collective of Plenty. She became Iansan's sparring partner when Iansan couldn't budge an adult saurian. Their first duel ended with both collapsing and no winner, and they stayed rivals for life, each racing to surpass the other. Emela grew larger than any Tatankasaurus in the tribe and became chief of the Tatankasaurs, but still let Iansan ride on her back to explore the wilds.

3.content: The patterned Tatankasaurus skull Iansan carries is Alaye. Emela found the spirit of a young Tatankasaurus that would not move on to the Night Kingdom. Iansan asked Citlali to bind it into its own skull, much as a Tzitzimitl is made, so it would neither lose its way nor fade. Alaye is shy and grunts encouragement during workouts when it thinks no one is around. Iansan believes it stayed because it wanted to grow up strong.

4.comment: Iansan: Uwezo and the Blood of Egungun
4.content: Uwezo ("Power") is a highly honoured Ancient Name in the Collective of Plenty. When it chose Iansan, a girl of the child-sized Egungun bloodline, much of the tribe thought her unworthy. Her family had always kept their heads down as medics and cooks. Iansan sees her training as her personal footnote to the name: "You need not be born with power. Toil is what truly imparts strength." The Pilgrim's Chronicle describes Uwezo's hand as one "extended to all who are lonely and sorrowful".

5.content: Iansan's training academy is open to any tribe, age or gender. She moved the fitness club close to the Stadium of the Sacred Flame to host it. Newcomers, disappointed by the "world-renowned coach", are invited to pick any exercise and compete against her; after they collapse, she adds ten to twenty more sets with their weights. She designs custom equipment so that people intimidated by free weights can still train.

6.comment: Iansan: Kachina and the Night Kingdom Rescue
6.content: Kachina came to Iansan's classes for years, often leaving defeated and apologising. Iansan waived her fees, felt she had failed her, and let her train any time. Both won the 5.0 Pilgrimage, and Iansan told Kachina it was an honour to fight beside her.
